  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows recent downward momentum.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — apply a lagged correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above/below 30-day moving average, pull toward it by 10-20%.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in low-sentiment periods — suppress sharp upward/downward moves.",
    "In high-sentiment periods, allow forecasts to trend with sentiment but cap extreme outliers at ±1.5x historical range.",
    "For 2024-02-08 to 2024-02-16, model underreacted to sentiment shifts — increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment history in early 2024.",
    "In 2024-04-15, forecast overestimated upward momentum — reduce forecast slope after 30-day high.",
    "In 2021-10-01 to 2021-10-08, model consistently overestimated downward moves — apply downward bias correction for negative sentiment."
  ]
}
